content: Individuals living with HIV are at an increased risk of developing prediabetes and diabetes. This risk is particularly pronounced in those undergoing antiretroviral (ARV) therapy. ARV medications can induce insulin resistance, which contributes to the development of hyperglycemia. Therefore, regular diabetes screenings are essential for this population to monitor and manage their glycemic status effectively. If hyperglycemia occurs, alternative therapeutic strategies may need to be considered to mitigate the impact on glucose metabolism.
